brief.en: Hurts and chills zombies that step on it
brief.zh: 对走过的僵尸造成伤害并使之冷冻

description.en: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
description.zh: 冰地刺对经过的僵尸造成伤害，并使之冷冻。

chat.en: Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
chat.zh: 冰地刺激动地收到了顶级联赛的召唤，迫不及待地想要开始让扎穿僵尸，冻时冷藏他们。他坚持要我们用“冻时”而不是“同时”。

text.en: can take three hits from rolling zombies when fed with Plantfood
text.zh: 使用叶绿素后能承受滚动前行的僵尸三次打击
